_comment: Citations for the Emperor's Children faction mechanics in code/simulator.py. Source: BSData v10.6.0 Chaos - Emperor's Children.cat.gz.

simulator.ec_daemonette_fights_first.rule_name: Daemonettes Fights First (detachment-gated via Carnival of Excess)
simulator.ec_daemonette_fights_first.quoted_text: <modifier type="set" value="true" field="hidden"><conditionGroups><conditionGroup type="and"><conditions><condition type="notInstanceOf" value="1" field="selections" scope="force" childId="cac3-71d1-ea4b-795d" shared="true" includeChildSelections="true"/><condition type="lessThan" value="1" field="selections" scope="roster" childId="3c9e-2156-254e-66e8" shared="true" includeChildSelections="true"/></conditions></conditionGroup></conditionGroups></modifier> ... <infoLink name="Fights First" id="fc22-54df-e539-41d9" hidden="false" type="rule" targetId="24-c886-e8ba-5a89"/>
simulator.ec_daemonette_fights_first.trigger: BSData selectionEntry id 06f6-b870-4e43-4ed9 (Daemonettes, Emperor's Children). The selectionEntry carries a modifier that sets the entry hidden=true UNLESS the force contains childId cac3-71d1-ea4b-795d (Emperor's Children faction entry) AND the roster contains childId 3c9e-2156-254e-66e8 (Carnival of Excess detachment). The Fights First infoLink (id fc22-54df-e539-41d9) is therefore only available when the Carnival of Excess detachment is active. The mapper's extract_fights_first() reads all infoLinks unconditionally, producing fights_first=True in every game regardless of detachment. This gate corrects that over-extraction. Env-gated SWEG_EC_DAEMONETTE_FF (default OFF). OFF is byte-identical to base.
simulator.ec_daemonette_fights_first.effect: When ON: in Battle._fight_priority, if the unit has faction='Emperor's Children' and name='Daemonettes', the fights_first profile flag is ignored and the unit fights in the Remaining Combats step (priority 2) rather than the Fights First step (priority 0). When OFF: no change — Daemonettes retain priority 0 as before (base behaviour preserved byte-for-byte).
